_about: English source for the Android app. Strings whose English text also exists in windows/src/i18n/strings.json (the desktop catalog, 10 languages) are translated from it by scripts/gen-strings.mjs; the others fall back to English until someone translates them in i18n/extra.json. Edit this file, then run: node android/scripts/gen-strings.mjs

strings.about_unofficial: Unofficial Android port based on Coucou by Louis Raillé.
